```{r}
sens_opt_df = read.csv('data/processed_sensitivity_opt_data.csv')
sens_opt_df = sens_opt_df %>% mutate(across(starts_with("cAb"), log10)) 
sens_opt_df$label = gsub("^(.*?)_", "", sens_opt_df$label, perl=T)
sens_opt_df_list = split(sens_opt_df %>% select(-c(replicate)), sens_opt_df$label)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
DR_Viz = function(dataset){
  std.err = function(x, na.rm = T) sd(x, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(x))
  
  dataset %>% select(-label) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc.),
                   names_to = 'pairs',
                   values_to = 'fluorescence') %>% 
  group_by(Conc., target_vector, pairs) %>%
  summarise(average_fluorescence = mean(fluorescence),
            se = std.err(fluorescence)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Conc., y=average_fluorescence, color = target_vector))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  labs(title = paste0(dataset$label, " Dose Response"),
       x = 'Spike Protein Concentration (ng/mL)',
       y = "Log(Fluorescence) (A.U.)")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=average_fluorescence-se, ymax = average_fluorescence+se), width = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap('pairs', scales = 'free')+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,5))+
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic()
}
lapply(sens_opt_df_list, DR_Viz)
```
```{r}
combined_augment_data = read.csv("Embedded_FS/combined_augmented_data.csv")
combined_augment_data = combined_augment_data %>% select(-c(Replicate, cAb13))
condition_label = sens_opt_df$label
sens_opt_df = sens_opt_df %>% select(-c(label, replicate))
condition_plus_target = paste0(sens_opt_df$target_vector, "_", condition_label)
condition_plus_target

# Because I'm not sure if UMAP can be precomputed then applied to a test set
# a quick fix

# UMAP visualization
umap_rec = recipe(~., data = combined_augment_data %>% filter(Conc. >= 0.01 & Conc. <= 25)) %>% 
  update_role(c(Conc., target_vector), new_role = "id") %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>% 
  step_umap(all_predictors())

umap_prep = prep(umap_rec)

# Here I construct the UMAP embedding by first training on the augmented data, then
# "predicting" on the new data. NOTE: I construct the manifold representation
# with ALL variants, then just filter out WT and Beta to make the visualization less cluttered
bake(umap_prep, new_data = NULL) %>% 
  filter(target_vector == "Beta" | target_vector == "WT") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = round(Conc., 3)))+
  geom_point(aes(color = target_vector))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans")

bake(umap_prep, new_data = sens_opt_df) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = Conc.))+
  geom_point(aes(color = condition_label))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans")

bake(umap_prep, new_data = sens_opt_df) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, alpha = Conc., label = target_vector))+
  geom_point(aes(color = condition_label))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans")

# To compute this represenation, I include the new data when constructing the intial embedding
sens_opt_combined_data = sens_opt_df
sens_opt_combined_data$target_vector = condition_plus_target
sens_opt_combined_data = bind_rows(sens_opt_combined_data, combined_augment_data) %>% 
  filter(Conc. >= 0.01 & Conc. <= 125)

umap_rec_combined = recipe(~., data = sens_opt_combined_data) %>% 
  update_role(c(Conc., target_vector), new_role = "id") %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>% 
  step_umap(all_predictors())

umap_prep_combined = prep(umap_rec_combined)

# Here I construct the UMAP embedding by first training on the augmented data, then
# "predicting" on the new data. NOTE: I construct the manifold representation
# with ALL variants, then just filter out WT and Beta to make the visualization less cluttered
combined_umap_test = bake(umap_prep_combined, new_data = NULL) %>% 
  filter(target_vector != "Omicron" & target_vector != "Delta") 

beta_combined_umap_test = combined_umap_test %>% filter(str_detect(target_vector, "Beta"))
WT_combined_umap_test = combined_umap_test %>% filter(str_detect(target_vector, "WT"))
beta_combined_umap_test %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, label = round(Conc., 3)))+
  geom_point(aes(color = target_vector))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_classic()

WT_combined_umap_test %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, alpha = round(Conc., 3)))+
  geom_point(aes(color = target_vector))+
  geom_text(check_overlap = T, hjust = "inward", family = "IBMPlexSans")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_classic()


```

```{r}
# Train models with combined augmented data, then test using the different condition test sets
train_data = combined_augment_data %>% filter(Conc. >= 0.01)
train_data$label = paste0(train_data$target_vector, "_Augment")

combined_sensitivity_opt = sens_opt_df
combined_sensitivity_opt$label = sens_opt_df$label
test_data = combined_sensitivity_opt

# Preprocessing - normalize, update Conc. and target_vector role, perform a UMAP decomposition, and 
preproc_rec = recipe(target_vector~., data = train_data) %>% 
  update_role(Conc., label, new_role = "id") %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) # %>% 
  # step_umap(all_predictors(),
  #           neighbors = 20,
  #           num_comp = 3)

rand_forest_mod = rand_forest(
  mtry = tune(),
  trees = 1000,
  min_n = tune()
) %>% 
  set_engine('ranger') %>% 
  set_mode('classification')

# mtry is a parameter estimated based on the training data, so we need to extract the parameter set and finalize using the training data
rf_param_set = extract_parameter_set_dials(rand_forest_mod) %>% 
  finalize(train_data %>% select(starts_with("cAb")))

rf_grid = grid_regular(rf_param_set,
                       levels = 5)
train_folds = vfold_cv(train_data, repeats = 2, strata = target_vector)

rand_workflow = workflow() %>% 
  add_model(rand_forest_mod) %>% 
  add_recipe(preproc_rec)

# Add hyperparameter tuning step and repeat with radial SVM
# Need to tune parameters

rand_fit = rand_workflow %>% 
  tune_grid(resamples = train_folds,
                grid = rf_grid,
            control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE, extract = extract_fit_engine))

collect_predictions(rand_fit, summarize = TRUE) %>% arrange(.row) %>% select(-.config)
collect_metrics(rand_fit)
best_tree_acc = select_best(rand_fit, metric = "accuracy")
show_best(rand_fit, metric = "roc_auc")
best_tree_acc

last_rf_mod = rand_forest(mtry = 3, min_n = 11, trees = 1000) %>% 
  set_engine("ranger", importance('impurity')) %>% 
  set_mode("classification")

final_rf_wf = rand_workflow %>% update_model(last_rf_mod)

# Last fit 
last_rf_fit = final_rf_wf %>% 
  fit()

fitted_pred = predict(final_rf_wf, test_data)
accuracy(fitted_pred$.pred_class, test_data$target_vector)
sum(fitted_pred$.pred_class == test_data$target_vector) # 36.3% acc (lower than if UMAP representation is not used)
```
